next.reason: 1985: 'If the current program collating sequence was not specified by an ALPHABET clause, the implementor determines the value.'; 2023: 'The returned value shall be the character in the alphanumeric program collating sequence having the ordinal position specified by argument-1.'. 1985 lets the implementor determine the value when no ALPHABET clause applies. 2023 always fixes it by ordinal position; only the choice among characters sharing a position is implementor-defined.
